🧠 BeeTrust AI Decision Support & Risk Engine Architecture

SIH Evaluator Transparency: Here is exactly what inputs are collected, how the model evaluates colony risks, and how the Trust Score is mathematically calculated.

1. Input Feature Vectors

FeatureSource & MethodSamplingSignificance
Hive Weight (Wt)IoT load-cell bridge sensorEvery 10 minNectar inflow, hive yield, absconding
Cluster Core Temp (Tt)Digital probe in brood clusterEvery 10 minThermoregulation, brood chilling/heat stress
Relative Humidity (Ht)Capacitive digital hygrometerEvery 10 minNectar curing, moisture accumulation
Rolling 48h Baseline (W̄48h)Rolling 48-hour time series windowDerivedFilters temporary diurnal foraging noise
Daily Weight Delta (ΔW)Wt − Wt−24h daily changeDerivedDaily productivity vs swarming mass loss

2. Model & Rule Logic

🔴 Colony Stress Classifier: Brood Core Temp > 38.0°C persistently for ≥ 30 minutes with flat or declining weight (ΔW ≤ 0). Indicates fanning ventilation exhaustion and high thermal risk.
🟡 Swarming / Decline Alert: Sudden acute weight loss (> 1.8 kg within 2–4 hours between 10:00 AM and 3:00 PM) accompanied by rapid temperature agitation spikes. Detects colony swarming or absconding.
🟢 Harvest Readiness & Yield Forecaster: Linear rate-of-gain projection reaching optimal super capacity (~42–45 kg) with stabilized moisture levels. Recommends ideal harvest window.
🟣 Regional Anomaly Correlation: Geospatial density correlation across district apiaries flagging pesticide contamination or floral collapse when > 40% of neighboring hives exhibit concurrent stress.

3. Trust Score (96/100 or 100/100) Mathematical Derivation

Deterministic weighted score based on 5 verifiable evidence pillars:

• 1. Source Apiary Geotag & Identity (w₁ = 20%): Registered KVIC beekeeper ID & GPS apiary verified. +20 pts
• 2. Continuous IoT Telemetry (w₂ = 20%): Unbroken 10-minute cadence, zero gaps during nectar flow. +20 pts
• 3. NABL Laboratory Chemical Analysis (w₃ = 25%): Moisture ≤ 20%, HMF ≤ 40 mg/kg, Diastase ≥ 8 (PASS). +25 pts
• 4. Institutional KVIC Sign-Off (w₄ = 20%): Authorized district officer review & digital verification seal. +20 pts
• 5. Cryptographic Block Ledger (w₅ = 15%): Immutable SHA-256 block creation & sequential parent link verified. +15 pts
Formula: Trust Score = (w₁ × S₁) + (w₂ × S₂) + (w₃ × S₃) + (w₄ × S₄) + (w₅ × S₅) = 20 + 20 + 25 + 20 + 15 = 100 / 100
Note on 96/100 in synthetic demo: A calibrated 4-point variance (-4 pts) applies when physical IoT sensors are simulated rather than live field hardware.

⛓️ Cryptographic Blockchain & Immutability Flow

Block Creation & Immutability Flow: Every approved honey batch generates a sequential, cryptographically linked block in our tamper-resistant ledger.
Ledger Chain Status: ✓ 100% IMMUTABLE & VERIFIED

Loading cryptographic block chain…

How Immutability Works

Each block contains the exact SHA-256 hash of the previous block (previous_hash), the Merkle snapshot hash of the honey batch (snapshot_hash), and the finalized laboratory evidence hash (lab_result_hash). Altering even a single decimal of moisture or weight changes the entire hash chain, immediately invalidating subsequent blocks.
